newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles rights issue well taken up.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles rights issue well taken up.

text.p: UK healthcare technology group Biocompatibles Plc said on Tuesday that 94.5 percent of the shares made available under its rights issue of just over 9.6 million new shares had been taken up at 500p by shareholders.
In accordance with the arrangements made ahead of the issue, subscribers have been procured for the balance of the shares at a price of 930 pence per share, the company said in a statement.
